title: UniProbe: A Learnable Token-Level Hallucination Detector for Large VLMs using Multi-Structural Internal Representations
abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) achieve impressive visual reasoning and dialogue capabilities, yet frequently hallucinate content unsupported by the visual input. Effective mitigation requires token-level localization, enabling targeted intervention without discarding the entire response. Existing detectors require expensive full-model fine-tuning, rely on external verifiers that ignore the model's generation process, or reduce internal signals to isolated features and hand-crafted statistics, discarding spatial, sequential, and relational structure. We introduce \textbf{UniProbe}, a lightweight, unified, learnable detector that models a frozen LVLM's heterogeneous computational trace from a single forward pass. UniProbe constructs a directed graph over image patches, query tokens, and generated tokens, with attention weights encoding their relations. It processes this trace with alternating structure-aware modules: a GNN for relational evidence, a ViT for 2-D visual geometry, and a GRU for response order. Interleaving them allows spatial, relational, and sequential evidence to interact throughout the detector. We further develop a streaming variant for hallucination-aware decoding, which detects and resamples hallucinated tokens during generation, and a self-adaptation strategy aligning the detector with the LVLM's own generations. Across diverse LVLM backbones, UniProbe achieves state-of-the-art token-level and object-hallucination detection. During decoding, it reduces object hallucinations by up to 55\% at $1.06\times$ the latency of standard generation.

analysis.ideaZh: UniProbe 从 MLLM 生成前 hidden states 训练统一 probe，同时做 hallucination detection 与 token grounding，避免仅在输出后找错误；作者在 MHALO/HalLoc 和 self-generation tests 报告提升，但方法要求访问内部 states，跨闭源模型、architecture 与 decoding regime 的泛化受限。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 对构建可信 MLLM/design agents 的生成前检查与可定位 failure signal 有实用参考。
analysis.evidenceZh: UniProbe 在解码前的 multimodal states 上同时估计 hallucination 与 token grounding。（Sec. 3 and Fig. 2, p. 4）；检测信号可用于 detector-guided re-decoding，而不只是事后分类。（Sec. 3.4, pp. 5-6）；作者报告在 MHALO 的 token detection、HalLoc localization 和 self-generation/object-hallucination detection 上优于所列 detectors。（Tables 1-3, p. 6）
analysis.caveatZh: 作者限制：方法要求访问 hidden states，且不同 MLLM architecture 的内部表示不统一。；审阅风险：probe accuracy 可能依赖 benchmark-specific annotation 和 model family，错误触发 re-decoding 也可能损害原本正确答案。
analysis.motivationZh: 方法在生成前的 multimodal representations 上定位与候选 tokens 相关的信号，联合训练 sequence-level hallucination score 和 token-level grounding/localization，并可触发 detector-guided re-decoding。它试图统一预警、定位与 mitigation，而非只依赖输出文本的一致性检查。
analysis.methodZh: 方法在生成前的 multimodal representations 上定位与候选 tokens 相关的信号，联合训练 sequence-level hallucination score 和 token-level grounding/localization，并可触发 detector-guided re-decoding。它试图统一预警、定位与 mitigation，而非只依赖输出文本的一致性检查。 贡献在统一 pre-generation detection 和 token localization，并展示同一 probe 可服务 self-generated outputs；本质仍是 access-dependent representation probing。
analysis.experimentsZh: 在 MHALO、HalLoc 与 self-generation protocols 上评估 sequence/token-level detection 和 localization，比较输出后 detector 与 hidden-state probes，并测试 re-decoding。 作者报告：作者报告在 MHALO 的 token detection、HalLoc localization 和 self-generation/object-hallucination detection 上优于所列 detectors。（Tables 1-3, p. 6） Baseline boundary：包含多类 hallucination detectors 和不同 backbones；但只有可访问 hidden states 的模型可用，闭源 API 和架构迁移比较不完整。 Ablation boundary：分析 pre-generation layers、probe inputs 和 mitigation；缺少跨版本/quantization/decoding-temperature 的稳定性与 calibration curves。
analysis.insightZh: 贡献在统一 pre-generation detection 和 token localization，并展示同一 probe 可服务 self-generated outputs；本质仍是 access-dependent representation probing。 建议略读 probe placement、localization 与 calibration；收录为内部-state diagnostic，不视为 model-agnostic hallucination solution。
